prompt: Best route to make 1-phenyl-1-propanone (propiophenone) from benzene?

options.label: Friedel–Crafts acylation with propanoyl chloride + AlCl₃
Friedel–Crafts alkylation with propyl chloride + oxidation (gives polyalkylation / rearrangement)

explanation: Friedel–Crafts acylation is the clean route (no polyacylation; no carbocation rearrangements). FC alkylation with n-propyl chloride would rearrange to isopropyl.
